No, a court would not enforce the bar against the distributor's assignment of its right to receive the $30,000. A general ban on assigning "the contract or any of its terms" is read as not reaching payment rights unless it specifically says so, so the assignment would still be effective, though the distributor could be liable to the center for breaching the promise. This assumes the clause does not mention payment rights specifically.

CONFIDENCE: 75
